ls-0ojD.title: Road lines: triple middle line
ls-0ojD.summary: Some roads have a centre made of two solid lines with a dashed line between them. Only a few southern African countries use it.

ls-4i78.title: Roads: free-roaming cows, horses and donkeys
ls-4i78.summary: Very rural: livestock wander the roads freely, most often cows, but also horses, donkeys and other farm animals.

ls-7YgM.title: Coverage: very sparse, towns in the north-west
ls-7YgM.summary: Coverage is very thin, especially in the south-east, where it is mostly limited to yellow roads. All city coverage is in the north-west.

ls-EKt9.title: Town: remote, among green mountains, bad weather
ls-EKt9.summary: A very recognisable town on the south-east border, far from other towns, in the middle of green mountains. The weather was noticeably bad when the car drove through.

ls-JzJz.title: Plate: long white, blue text, hat symbol
ls-JzJz.summary: Long white plates with blue text. If not fully blurred, you may see a small straw hat symbol on the left.

ls-Ne2W.title: Landscape: short grass
ls-Ne2W.summary: Grasslands have mostly short grass. This helps tell it apart from Eswatini, which has lots of tall grass.

differs.how: Eswatini has lots of tall grass

ls-TZam.title: Google car: white, no antenna, Gen 3
ls-TZam.summary: All coverage is Gen 3, usually showing the back of a white car with no antenna. Eswatini, Botswana and South Africa share it, though South Africa's Gen 3 is rare.

ls-ed3U.title: Landscape: mountain region, road on the slope
ls-ed3U.summary: In the mountains the road hugs the slope. Big green grassy mountains are close. Only 6 main roads have coverage, so you can learn each of them.

ls-fu9e.title: People: traditional clothing and woollen blankets
ls-fu9e.summary: Many people wear traditional clothing, especially thick woollen blankets draped over the shoulders.

ls-k5TG.title: Coverage: raindrops on lens, east of reservoir
ls-k5TG.summary: On part of the A25, just east of the big reservoir, raindrops cover the camera in one direction.

ls-kqbl.title: Road lines: yellow edges, white centre
ls-kqbl.summary: Yellow lines at the road edge and white lines in the middle. The other southern African countries use the same.

ls-kxM2.title: Landscape: bare tabletop mountains, rocky ridges
ls-kxM2.summary: Bare, treeless mountains, often flat-topped, with horizontal rocky ridgelines. In the south-east they look more like rolling green hills, but the ridges are still visible.

ls-mefQ.title: Houses: round thatched huts
ls-mefQ.summary: In rural areas, round huts with thatched roofs are common. Neighbouring countries have them less often but not never.

ls-njvL.title: Plants: agave plants in the countryside
ls-njvL.summary: Agave plants, spiky succulents with thick pointed leaves, are common across the countryside and make a good clue.

ls-p4dx.title: City: the only truly urban downtown
ls-p4dx.summary: Only the capital has a properly urban centre. Other towns feel provincial, and even the capital's suburbs can look rural.

ls-q6tO.title: Landscape: two large man-made reservoirs
ls-q6tO.summary: Two big reservoirs are visible from some mountain roads: the larger from the A25, the smaller from an A3 side road. Don't mix them up with the small industrial lake near a diamond mine.

ls-qWpp.title: Bollard: white-painted stick, roadworks
ls-qWpp.summary: Parts of the A5 are under construction, with a mostly white-painted stick as a temporary bollard. The road itself is wide dirt with very dark brown soil.

ls-rdOK.title: Landscape: flat region, mountains far from road
ls-rdOK.summary: In the flat region the road runs over flat or hilly land, with flat-topped mountains standing farther away, so you get a clear view. This region has the most coverage, villages and farming.

ls-t2FE.title: Driving side: left
ls-t2FE.summary: Traffic drives on the left, as in the other southern African countries.

ls-uroc.title: Road: light-brown dirt, high grassy mountains
ls-uroc.summary: In the south-east near the South African border, guess here if all hold: unpaved light-brown road, good weather with small fluffy clouds, and high grassy mountains. Pale rocks often line the road.

ls-ylee.title: Road: by far the best surface
ls-ylee.summary: The A2 between the capital and Mafeteng has the best road quality in the country.
